lines: Status 204 · 2026-11-27 08:15 UTC · Phase 6

Decision needed from Brandon, unchanged, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end. He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread. The Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

Three corrections of mine, said first. One: chain 23's note says the tree's tenth pass is held if the miniature reads under 0.85 at review. Right is: 0.85 is the aim, and a tenth pass that reads over the ninth's 0.807 and stands nearer the approved in form is merged. Two: I took spring's shake 2 cover with the new moss collar as 0.9042. Its builder corrected me: it reads 0.8964 (131,599 of 146,813 miniature pixels hidden, STATED), a pass over the threshold of 0.85 and under my aim of 0.90; 13,029 of the 15,214 bare pixels lie in one band of ground at the front left. I ruled against a taller collar: its moss line stands at 113 pixels where the approved's stands at 106, and raising it would leave the approved for a measure that already passes. Three: at 08:06 UTC I told summer's air builder its picture of the seeds at three times was looked at when it was not. I looked at 08:13 UTC and sent what it shows; that message is stamped 08:15 and left at 08:14.

Chain 23 is read whole and on origin main (`7cd99d2b`, pushed 08:08 UTC): summer's tree, ninth pass. On it: tsc exit 0, build exit 0, "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8066" with the base at 0.838 and the miniature at 0.807 (chain 22's miniature read 0.901, so the ninth crown holds less fine detail and the tenth has to win it back), M4 0.9694, 0.8677, 0.9544, 0.9586 and M5 0.9934, 1, 0.9783, 0.9996, all pass; the whole vitest 68 files passed and 1 skipped, 941 tests passed and 4 skipped; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass.

Chain 24 is running since 08:08 UTC on two merges, not on origin yet: summer's base, seventh list (`35ee2639`) and the controls' second job (summer's dressing made in steps). Read so far: tsc exit 0, the base made again, build exit 0, engine `2a6dc113bef56d16`, "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8067" with the base at 0.833 and the miniature at 0.807; M4 0.9694, 0.8677, 0.9544, 0.9586 and M5 0.9934, 1, 0.9783, 0.9996, all pass and equal to chain 23's. Its stills, counts and the whole vitest are still running, done about 08:29 UTC.

Picture 1 is summer at rest on chain 24, the approved picture left and the build right. Measured on this pair before any word about tone: the base's levels match the approved's (luma at the 10th, 50th and 90th percentile 42, 71, 123 for the approved and 40, 74, 139 for the build; mean colour 87,76,62 against 91,81,69). So the base is not too dark, though it looks so to the eye. What is missing is form: the approved's carved ridges with thin lit crests where the build has soft broad bands. Its builder holds that order: crisp lit crest edges at the approved's count, the dashed gold line out, the lip, the pale disc under the foot. First pair 08:50 UTC, push 09:30 UTC. Below the bar.
Picture 2 is summer's base at full 4K size from the same list. Shells and sea glass hold at 4K. The sand's bands are soft and blurred and the dashed gold line shows. Below the bar.

Picture 3 is fall's base at the flank: the approved picture left, main in the middle, the tenth step right, not pushed. The tenth has the dark body with thin long lit lines that I ruled for. Push 08:40 UTC. Below the bar.

Picture 4 is summer's seeds at three times: the approved picture left and the air builder's working tree right, not pushed. The approved's heads carry some 30 to 40 hair thin spokes with a bright warm heart, in at least four sizes, and a few trail a stalk with a seed; the build's carry some 14 to 18 thick spokes in nearly one size with no stalk. The approved's lights are soft glows from about 2 to 30 pixels; the build's are even discs with a ring. Sent as counts and form, no level. One push with the landing 09:15 UTC. Below the bar.

Summer's glass, fourth list, pushed 08:14 UTC (`15692562`, STATED by its builder, not looked at by me yet and not merged): the grey white smear is gone from the upper middle, "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8394" on its head. Its own word, below the bar: the pale arc across the top is one smooth band and not thin arcs, the low left burn is a soft leaf and not a flame, the upper left has no comb of streaks, the left outline at the landing is a thin dark line. The glint is not in it.

4K motion, the shutter builder's report (STATED, measured and limited): winter, summer's base and table, fall's base, web and ground hold between frames; summer's lawn and fall at speed are not judged. I looked at two of its ten pictures so far, summer through the glass and fall's base, four slow frames each at full size, and saw no crawl in them. Ordered: the lawn on four 3840 frames with the air off as a measuring aid, and fall at speed on film frames 2364 to 2367, both by 09:00 UTC. Not a pass.

The controls: the second job is in chain 24 on its builder's stated proofs; its own report (strict, determinism, stand ins, the walk of items 9 and 10) is still to come and the push is held if it names a failure. Its third job, a season pressed before its hand to the graphics card is over is waited for, needs two lines in two files that are not its own; leave given for exactly those lines, proven whole on the newest main.

The change of season: nothing pushed. Its flash cut mend is ruled and in work, one line with a strip about 09:15 UTC, push about 10:45 UTC. Shake 2's cover stands at 0.8677, 0.018 over its threshold. Below the bar.

Preview 06, the next rough draft of the whole film: 6 of 12 ranges are in (film frames 0 to 598, 1200 to 1798, 2400 to 2998), limit 08:45 UTC. It comes attached with a status after it is joined and looked at, about 09:00 UTC. It is drawn on `d2013ce3` and does not hold the tree's ninth pass.

The live app is still the fifth publish. The next publish is planned about 09:15 UTC, when the draft machines end and a slot is free for the security review; all 16 slots are at work (13 builders, 3 draft machines).

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 23's counts and vitest, chain 24's measures. On helper machines: the builders' own stills and two more ranges of Preview 06. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
